Callout.Name: Transport Incident
Callout.Message: Prisoner transport stopped, inmate refusing to comply.
Callout.Advisory: Inmate secured in the van, two officers on scene.

Script.Line: He will not get out of the van. He has been sat there twenty minutes.
He is cuffed and he is going nowhere, but then neither are we.
Two of us and one of him, and we both want to go home tonight.

Lines.Approach: The van is stopped and he will not walk. Two officers are with him and they want a hand.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
